title: Pre-biopsy With Dynamic Acquisitions
brief_summary: This study is being done to test the ability of an investigational mammography camera to find small tumors in patients' breasts.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Have a lesion on Mammogram, Ultrasound or MRI that measured \< 2 cm and considered suspicious or suggestive of malignancy
* Scheduled for biopsy of lesion
* \> 18 years of age
* Negative pregnancy test, postmenopausal, or surgically sterilized

Exclusion Criteria:

* Prior needle biopsy
study_population: Patients that are scheduled to have a biopsy at the Mayo Clinic in Rochester, MN and have a lesion less the 2 cm
